instruction: Deterministic UUID Regeneration The file /home/user/Desktop/design.kicad_pcb has randomized UUIDs on its footprints, track segments, and vias. The file /home/user/Desktop/seed.txt contains a seed string. You must replace all UUIDs with deterministic values derived from the seed. Read /home/user/Desktop/seed.txt to get the seed string. For each element, compute its new UUID as: hashlib.md5(f"{seed}:{identifier}".encode()).hexdigest() Formatted as: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx (32 hex chars split 8-4-4-4-12). Identifiers: - Footprint: its Reference designator (e.g., "R1"). - Segment: "{start_x},{start_y},{end_x},{end_y},{layer},{net}" using values as parsed from s-expr. - Via: "{at_x},{at_y},{layer1},{layer2}" using values from (at) and (layers) nodes. Requirements: 1. All footprint, segment, and via UUIDs replaced with deterministic hashes. 2. No two elements share the same UUID. 3. Non-UUID fields (positions, widths, nets, pad assignments) identical to input. 4. Running the same algorithm on the same input always produces the same UUIDs. Write /home/user/Desktop/design.kicad_pcb. [Software] To use KiCad, run `kicad` for the GUI or `kicad-cli` for scripting/headless use (use PATH or the full install path).
